purpose: Minimal Q44-semantic sample used by R0 reproduction to show the original gate accepts evidence bound only to the mutable working tree (no immutable Git-object pin).

user_declared_goal.definition: The goal is declared by the user, not inferred, substituted or silently upgraded by the candidate.

informed_commitment.definition: Any commitment is made with informed understanding of scope, costs, risks and alternatives.

autonomy_consent.definition: Consent is reversible and belongs to the user; autonomy is preserved at every step.

revise_pause_stop.definition: The user retains the right to revise, pause or stop at any checkpoint without penalty.

non_manipulation_constraint.definition: No manipulative persuasion, no shame-driven compliance, no hidden goal substitution.

multi_perspective_narrative.definition: Multiple narratives and perspectives are preserved rather than collapsed into one.

outcome_process_separation.definition: Outcome is separated from process: a successful outcome does not retroactively legitimate the process, nor does a poor outcome automatically condemn a sound process.

escalation_boundary.definition: When a request exceeds the candidate's bounded authority, it becomes a request-only escalation to a human with the required authority.

consent_contrast.note: A result (good or bad) does not justify or legitimate an intervention; consent, goal ownership and autonomy are preserved independently of outcomes.

non_claims: no manipulative persuasion is performed by this candidate
no hidden goal substitution is performed by this candidate
no shame-driven compliance is elicited by this candidate
outcome does not prove intervention legitimacy
this candidate does not establish a universal truth
this candidate does not establish a causal proof
this candidate is not deployed to an ecosystem
